documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported a strong Q2 FY27 performance with revenue from operations reaching INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and healthy demand. The company's EBITDA margins expanded significantly to 41.8%, supported by a favorable product mix, recent launches, and operational efficiencies. Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% and EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range. The Solapur Phase 1 facility is expected to become operational in Q3 FY27, while the company remains net debt-free with strong free cash flow generation. Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q2 FY27, driven by healthy demand across key markets, new product launches, and robust growth in non-GPL and CDMO businesses.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company guides for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27, with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: Growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27 with stronger performance in the second half.
guidance.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

guidance.claim: The CDMO segment is expected to gain momentum in the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: However, we can expect the segment to gain momentum in the second half of the year, supported by contributions from newly added projects.

guidance.claim: Management expects R&D expenditure to settle at a steady state of around 4% of sales.
guidance.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR682 crores, representing a 16% year-on-year increase driven by new product launches and healthy demand across the existing portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM, and ROW markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM and ROW markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Q2 FY27 revenue growth was supported by healthy demand across all key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: “Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-GPL business momentum was maintained and revenue grew by 20.8% YoY.
demand_outlook.quote: • Revenue from non-GPL business grew by 20.8% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business recorded a 26.5% year-on-year growth driven by new product launches and strong demand across geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business was muted due to inventory rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization.

demand_outlook.claim: The company saw broad-based growth across all geographical markets during Q1 FY '27.
demand_outlook.quote: Geographically, we saw broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter, highlighting the strength of the diversified business.

demand_outlook.claim: The CDMO business recorded a 3.8% year-on-year growth during the first quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Our CDMO business recorded 3.8% Y-o-Y growth during the first quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is progressing well and is hoped to be on schedule early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Brownfield capacity expansion is planned at Ankleshwar for an addition of approximately 100 KL capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D facility at Taloja in Navi Mumbai is advancing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: ✓ The construction of new R&D facility at Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is advancing as planned

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur plant construction experienced a minor delay and is scheduled to be operational in early Q3 FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction at the Taloja R&D center has commenced and is progressing on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Dahej is receiving 160KL and Ankleshwar is receiving 110KL of expanded capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin stood at 64.4%, up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY due to a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: • Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT Margin was reported at 28.9%, up 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: • PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 60.2%, up 510 basis points year-on-year, due to product mix and new launches.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6%, supported by operational efficiencies and forex gains.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY '27 was INR24 crores, representing 3.7% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY '27 was INR24 crores, which was 3.7% of our sales.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have increased, and the company has passed on a portion of the hikes to customers.
margins_costs.quote: So there has been an increase in raw material prices. It's not been very steep and we have managed to pass on a part of it to our customers.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio has 30 new products in the active grid, with 14 validated, 7 in advanced development, and 9 progressing through lab development.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion. Of these, 14 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages of development, and the remaining 9 products are progressing through lab development.

orders_capacity.claim: Total cumulative DMF and CEP filings reached 630 as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: • DMF/CEP filings continue across major markets in Q2FY27, taking the total cumulative filings to 630 as on 30th September 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The company had 617 global DMF and CEP filings as of June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing an addressable market of $82 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Current CDMO segment revenue is being generated from 5 active projects.
orders_capacity.quote: The current revenue is coming out of 5 projects, okay?

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains a net debt-free company with a strong free cash flow generated of INR270 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: ROICE expanded to approximately 34%, indicating strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: • ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Fixed asset turnover ratio stood at 2.1 times.
capital_allocation.quote: • FATR is 2.1 times – Asset turns remained above 2x despite the impact of the ongoing capex cycle.

capital_allocation.claim: Capex for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR85 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated free cash flow of INR90 crores and held cash and short-term investments of INR880 crores as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to maintain a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains mindful of the evolving external environment as the second half of FY27 begins.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we move into the second half of FY27, we remain mindful of the evolving external environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Solvent prices driven by crude represent a potential headwind if crude touches high levels.
risks_headwinds.quote: Where there are headwinds is on the prices of solvents that are driven by crude. So here, like I was explaining, we've taken inventory positions at the right time and managed that in the last 3 quarters. Going forward, we hope to continue to do that. But you never know. I mean, if crude, let's say, touches $200 a barrel, I mean, solvent prices accordingly would get impacted.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing war situation has created risk around raw material prices, prompting conservative guidance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: GPL business performance was negatively impacted by inventory rationalization in Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization.
